facts.statement: SOE ran a Station Cash double day (Station Cash em Dobro) on Saturday April 30, from 4 AM to 3:59 AM Sunday May 1 Brasilia time (8 AM to 7:59 AM Portugal time), as a thank-you after a service interruption.
facts.quote: um dia do Station Cash Dobrado, neste Sábado, dia 30 de abril

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language SOE news post announcing a Station Cash double day across SOE's portfolio of games on Saturday April 30 (after a recent service interruption), as an apology. It also says SOE was working on a make-good plan for PS3 players of DC Universe Online and Free Realms, with details to follow on the game forums and websites.
